title: Nigeria Payment Service Providers
description: Independently compiled factual reference data for the current Central Bank of Nigeria payment-service-provider register snapshot. Each record represents one provider-category membership across the seven approved CBN PSP sections.
methodology: Independently compiled and cross-verified factual reference data from the public Central Bank of Nigeria PSP register. The register was retrieved three times with consistent results on 2026-08-29. Observed counts: mobile_money_operator 17; switching_and_processing_company 19; payment_solution_service_provider 108; payment_terminal_service_provider 47; super_agent 61; payment_service_holding_company 1; payment_terminal_service_aggregator 2. SoftData anchored extraction to the seven approved PSP sections and excluded card schemes, payment schemes, clearing-house content, IMTOs and adjacent page material. The CBN register is mutable; these counts describe the verified snapshot and do not establish a universal institution identifier. Former-name annotations were preserved in the working audit, then removed from the public display name only when clearly indicated.

sources.title: Payment Service Providers
sources.purpose: Verify the seven approved PSP sections, the current provider-category counts, and the public snapshot used for compilation.
